item.title: ProPresenter Library 0.1.0
item.description:
The first release of ProPresenter Library.

  • Browse every library in your ProPresenter workspace, search by title, author, CCLI number or lyrics, and preview slides.
  • Check presentations against a house style and apply it to many at once, after seeing every change.
  • Archive or move presentations to another library. Playlists that use them follow to the new location.
  • Last used dates, with lists of presentations that haven't been used in a while.
  • Categories sorted by Apple Intelligence on your Mac.
  • Clean up titles and section names with the Codex CLI, approving each suggestion.
  • Every change is backed up and can be undone from History.
